core_philosophy: Simple for users, powerful behind the scenes. 5-minute learning curve. Max 3-click rule.

theme_strategy.archetype: Soft Utility & Old Money Tech (Elegant, Professional, High Clarity)
theme_strategy.aesthetic: Rounded components, elegant soft shadows, high-density grids for data, clean uncluttered surfaces.

fonts.headings: Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif (Elegant, distinctive, slightly wide)
fonts.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif (Highly legible, modern, professional)

hierarchy.h1_page_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-50
hierarchy.h2_section_title: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100
hierarchy.overline_label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400

rules: NEVER use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Always use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings 24px and larger.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all tabular data and dashboard metrics for crisp number alignment.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Desktop-first responsive. High density for dashboard data, generous breathing room for reading views (Notes, Meetings).
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Fixed width 260px (desktop), highly collapsible. Unified navigation. Uses subtle background contrast from main content.
spacing_and_layout.header: Sticky top bar. MUST USE backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 (light) or bg-zinc-950/80 (dark). NEVER use fully transparent background.
spacing_and_layout.content_area: Padding p-6 to p-10 depending on screen size. Uses 'High Density Grid' (Bento grid logic: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) for dashboard widgets.
spacing_and_layout.container_radii: Rounded components required. Cards: rounded-2xl. Buttons/Inputs: rounded-xl. Badges: rounded-full.

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl font-medium shadow-sm hover:bg-indigo-700 hover:shadow active:scale-[0.98] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 rounded-xl hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-all
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 rounded-xl transition-all

status_badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

progress_bars.fill: bg-indigo-600 rounded-full h-full transition-all duration-500 ease-out

micro_interactions.hover: All interactive elements MUST have visible hover states. Lighter hue for backgrounds, explicit text color definitions.
micro_interactions.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 focus:outline-none. High accessibility.
micro_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform) NEVER 'transition: all' to prevent breaking layout transforms.
micro_interactions.active: Buttons should have active:scale-[0.98] to feel tactile.

iconography: lucide-react (Standard, lightweight, matches the 'Soft Utility' aesthetic perfectly)
general_ui_ux_guidelines: MAX 3-CLICK RULE: Every core action (Add Task, Log Meeting, Change Status) must be reachable within 3 clicks from anywhere.
ONE-CLICK CONVERSION: Action Items in Meetings must have a prominent, single-click 'Jadikan Tugas' (Convert to Task) button.
AUTOMATION VISIBILITY: Auto-calculated progress bars (from checklists) should have subtle animation when updating to show system intelligence.
UNIFIED CALENDAR: Use explicit color-coding dot indicators for Meetings vs Task Deadlines vs Reminders.
OPTICAL ALIGNMENT: Pad icons in buttons slightly off-center geometrically to achieve optical centering.
DATA ATTRIBUTES: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="btn-tambah-tugas"`).
EMPTY STATES: Never leave a data table or list blank. Provide beautiful, soft-illustrated empty states with clear 'Create New' CTAs.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React application using .js files (NOT .tsx). Adjust all Shadcn component integrations to plain JavaScript.
Implement Dual Theme (Dark/Light mode) strictly using Tailwind 'dark:' utility classes.
Follow the defined Status Colors meticulously. Badges must use the explicit bg/text/border combinations.
Translate all UI text to professional Indonesian (e.g., Dashboard, Manajemen Tugas, Rapat, Kalender, Pengaturan).
Ensure the Sidebar is collapsible but maintains icon visibility to maximize screen real estate for the 'High Density Grid' content.
For rich-text notes in Meeting Management, implement a clean toolbar (TipTap or standard Shadcn formatting buttons) without heavy borders.
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (e.g., 'Tugas berhasil disimpan').
DO NOT output standard centered generic templates. Ensure deep z-index layers with shadows, crisp borders, and refined padding (e.g., p-6 or p-8 inside cards).
